description: Simulate a real GPU datacenter with zero GPUs — real Kubernetes GPU-resource scheduling (a fake device-plugin or run-ai/fake-gpu-operator), a real training/inference API and Next.js UI, and a real Prometheus/Grafana/ Langfuse observability stack, so anyone can learn distributed training/inference i…

ProxySQL, the MySQL-protocol proxy: connection pooling, read/write splitting, query routing and backend failover for MySQL and MariaDB. Hardened by QuenchWorks as a minimal, nonroot, 0-CVE image, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Squid, the caching forward proxy for HTTP and HTTPS (CONNECT). Pods reach the outside through it, and it caches repeat fetches in memory. Hardened by QuenchWorks as a minimal, nonroot, 0-CVE image, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
